model: Ventostat T8000 series CO2 sensor, BACnet MS/TP
applies_to: Amphenol Telaire Ventostat T8000 BACnet series CO2 transmitters (T8100 wall, T8200 dual channel, T8300 duct/pitot), with optional humidity, temperature and relay.
summary: The Ventostat T8000 BACnet series are NDIR CO2 transmitters with BACnet MS/TP on RS485. Four Analog Inputs give CO2, humidity and two temperatures; Analog Values hold offsets, relay setpoint and hysteresis, elevation, single-point calibration, baud and MAC; Binary Values switch temperature units and ABC Logic self-calibration and start a calibration.
notes: The object table has no read/write column; Analog and Binary Values are listed as writable (settings and commands), inputs as read-only.
Units are as printed in the table; AV 1, AV 5 and AV 7 point to footnotes (offset always °C, elevation always meters, baud in bits per second).
Humidity, relay and thermistor objects only work if that option was ordered; the relay commands have no effect otherwise.
Temperature units depend on factory options or BV 1; the temperature offset (AV 1) is always in °C and elevation (AV 5) always in meters.

source.title: Telaire Ventostat 8000 BACnet Series CO2 Sensor - User Instructions

integration.summary: Set the MAC on the DIP switches (and 9600 or 38400 baud on the last switch), then read AI 1 for CO2 and the humidity/temperature inputs if fitted.
setup: MAC address from the left seven DIP switches (1-127; 0 is the router); the rightmost switch sets 38400 (on) or 9600 (off) baud.
19200 and 76800 baud can be set through AV 7 over BACnet.
Device instance is 568000 plus the MAC address.
gotchas: Turn ABC Logic off (BV 2) in spaces that are never unoccupied, such as greenhouses or 24-hour buildings.
Set elevation (AV 5) for the site so CO2 readings are pressure-corrected.
